biomarkers.name: ASXL1, BCOR, EZH2, RUNX1, SF3B1, SRSF2, STAG2, U2AF1, ZRSR2 (MDS-related gene mutations)
biomarkers.prevalence: Defined as AML with myelodysplasia-related gene mutations in WHO 2022 / ICC 2022 when one or more of these mutations is present, in the appropriate clinicopathologic context
biomarkers.clinical_use: Presence of one or more of these mutations supports classification as AML with myelodysplasia-related features/AML myelodysplasia-related, excluding cases with defining recurrent genetic abnormalities

biomarkers.name: MDS-related cytogenetics (complex karyotype, -5/del(5q), -7/del(7q), i(17q)/t(17p), -13/del(13q), del(11q), del(12p)/t(12p), del(9q), idic(X)(q13), and certain other MDS-related abnormalities recognized by WHO/ICC)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in AML with myelodysplasia-related features
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic classification feature and generally adverse-risk

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.prevalence: Enriched in cases with complex karyotype and therapy-related or myelodysplasia-related AML compared with de novo AML

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Blast proliferation with multilineage dysplasia (dysgranulopoiesis, dyserythropoiesis, dysmegakaryopoiesis) — background changes may resemble underlying MDS, although morphology alone is no longer sufficient for classification in WHO 2022/ICC 2022
variants: AML with prior MDS or MDS/MPN history
AML with MDS-related cytogenetic abnormalities (complex, -5/del(5q), -7/del(7q), etc.)
AML with MDS-related gene mutations (ASXL1, BCOR, EZH2, RUNX1, SF3B1, SRSF2, STAG2, U2AF1, ZRSR2)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: As per AML_NOS; often reflects underlying MDS marrow biology
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Bone marrow dysplasia; marrow may be hypercellular, normocellular, or hypocellular, and fibrosis can be present in some subsets

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC or committed myeloid progenitor arising in the setting of preceding clonal hematopoiesis, MDS, or MDS/MPN
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Myeloid maturation arrest with multilineage dysplasia; background changes often reflect antecedent MDS biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Clonal evolution from MDS or MDS/MPN to AML through acquisition of additional driver lesions; common MDS-related mutations include ASXL1, BCOR, EZH2, RUNX1, SF3B1, SRSF2, STAG2, U2AF1, and ZRSR2
